name: Floor-plate efficiency (sample)
question: How much of a typical tower floor is usable once the core is taken out?
method: Reads the core share Tower Design Toolkit sizes to the lifts and stairs (or the share you set) and reports net-to-gross on a typical tower floor, plus the net area that is left.
human: Which efficiency a tenant or developer will accept for this use and height, and whether a bigger core buys something worth it (sky lobbies, public lifts, wider stairs).
limits: A sample package for the development registry: its thresholds are team presets, not a sourced benchmark. Only the core is deducted; columns, walls and shafts outside the core are not.

source.label: Sample registry entry: a team preset for demonstration, not a sourced benchmark
source.page: Replace with a sourced value before relying on it (research P08-M02 lists comparators)

metrics.label: Net area on a typical floor

createdWith: Tower Design Toolkit sample registry (development data, not a real submission)
